evidence.title: Next.js + Supabase Auth starter template with shadcn-UI and Tailwind CSS

name: supa-next-shad-auth
summary: Next.js + Supabase authentication starter template with shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, server actions and Zod.
description: A starter template for apps with Supabase authentication: Next.js, TypeScript, shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS, with secured server actions and Zod validation. The README covers Supabase project setup, test credentials in .env.local.example, and links a live Vercel demo.
contains: Next.js + Supabase auth starter with shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS
sign-up and login flows with a live Vercel demo
secure Next.js server actions and Zod validation, fully type-safe
